import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
import pandas as pd


def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    if not isinstance(df1, pd.DataFrame) or not isinstance(df2, pd.DataFrame):
        raise TypeError("df1 and df2 must both be pandas DataFrame objects.")

    if "id" not in df1.columns or "id" not in df2.columns:
        raise KeyError("Both dataframes must contain an 'id' column.")

    if column1 not in df1.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{column1}' not found in df1.")
    if column2 not in df2.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{column2}' not found in df2.")

    left = df1[["id", column1]].rename(columns={column1: "__column1__"})
    right = df2[["id", column2]].rename(columns={column2: "__column2__"})

    merged = left.merge(right, on="id", how="inner")

    if merged.empty:
        raise ValueError("No matching rows found after merging on 'id'.")

    merged = merged.dropna(subset=["__column1__", "__column2__"])

    if merged.empty:
        raise ValueError("No valid rows remain after dropping missing values.")

    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(merged["__column1__"], merged["__column2__"])

    if contingency_table.empty:
        raise ValueError("Contingency table is empty and cannot be analyzed.")

    _, p, _, _ = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)

    heatmap = sns.heatmap(contingency_table, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues")
    heatmap.set_title("Contingency Table Heatmap")
    heatmap.set_xlabel(column2)
    heatmap.set_ylabel(column1)

    return float(p), heatmap
